messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

Ashutosh Ghodasara

ashutosh ghodasara... that's a name with some weight to it. gujarati roots, i'm guessing?

GT

GT... grant thornton? found you on linkedin - Sr. Risk Analyst Associate. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/ashutoshghodasara

risk analysis at one of the big 4... numbers, compliance, the whole audit game. how long you been grinding in this space?
4.5 years now

4.5 years at grant thornton... that's some serious time in the audit trenches. bet you've seen every possible way companies can mess up their books. 

what made you stick with risk analysis this long? most people either love the detective work or get bored of finding other people's mistakes.
Yeah I'm t looking to switch

makes total sense. 4.5 years is enough time to master the game and realize you want to play a different one.

what kind of role you looking for next? staying in risk but maybe fintech/banking, or thinking of jumping to something completely different?
As long as it's around data analysis and power apps, power automate, alteryx tableau etc

ahh so you're done with just finding problems... now you want to solve them with data. power apps, alteryx, tableau - that's the whole business intelligence stack right there.

smart move. companies are throwing money at people who can turn messy data into pretty dashboards that actually help make decisions.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Remote or Pune
4.5 years risk analysis + data analytics with power apps/tableau + remote/pune... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yup
